Access Control Providing a comprehensive range of access control products, including card access systems, facial recognition terminals, PIN code entry devices, QR code access solutions, and integrated management software, designed to enhance security and streamline entry processes for various environments. Turnstiles Featuring a diverse range of turnstile products, including high tripod turnstiles, swing turnstiles, flap turnstiles, and full-height turnstiles, designed to enhance security and effectively manage access control in various environments and applications, ensuring safety, efficiency, and user convenience. Video Wall Offering a comprehensive range of video wall solutions, including ultra-narrow bezel video walls and a variety of video wall controllers, designed to deliver stunning visual displays for monitoring, presentations, and public information in diverse settings. LED Videotron Providing a wide range of LED Videotron products, including indoor and outdoor displays, rental options, flexible modules for curved installations, and advanced video wall controllers, catering to various advertising and event needs. Parking System Offering a comprehensive range of parking system solutions, including barrier gates, license plate recognition cameras, speed detection systems, and radar technology for anti-fall protection, designed to enhance security and streamline vehicle access management.
